in_sanskrit.name: निसर्ग
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: अन्ततः (anatas) – beyond, uttara-adhik (uttar-adhik) – more towards, vijñāna (vijñana) – knowledge. The name Nisarg can be interpreted as ‘that which is beyond knowledge’, or ‘that which is more towards knowledge’, or simply ‘the source of knowledge’.

in_telugu.name: నిసర్జ్
in_telugu.long_meaning: అదేశ (adēśa) – beyond, ఉత్తరాధిక (uttarādhika) – more towards, జ్ఞానము (jñānamu) – knowledge. The name Nisarg can be interpreted as ‘that which is beyond knowledge’, or ‘that which is more towards knowledge’, or simply ‘the source of knowledge’.

in_marathi.name: Nisarg
in_marathi.long_meaning: Nisarg हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit word निसर्ग (nisarga), meaning 'not created'. In Hindu mythology, Nisarg is the embodiment of nature and the essence of all things. It is also the name of a sage and a planet in Hindu astrology.
